findings.claim: Hypothesis Engine can confirm/refute passive hypotheses using later idle thoughts/conversation text from the same system via lexical/sentiment heuristics and feed success/failure back into hypothesis outcome processing; repeatedly untestable experimental hypotheses are downgraded to passive.
findings.implication: Self-generated passive matches are local consistency/salience signals, not independent evidence, causal confirmation or replication. Evidence ancestry/class must travel with every hypothesis status.

findings.claim: Relation/behavior/temporal hypothesis evaluation relies on generic lexical relation verbs, Jaccard overlap and sentiment direction terms.
findings.implication: Expose measurement operator/false-positive class and require matched nulls or typed observations before mechanism promotion.

findings.claim: News-Intel raw ingestion stores source provenance but no source-credibility weighting in KnowledgeGraph.ingest_data_point; co-mentioned entity relations receive fixed 0.3 relation confidence across source classes. Optional 4chan material is stored under generic source_type='web'.
findings.implication: Separate discoverability/activation/co-mention from truth confidence. Preserve source credibility/ancestry as typed evidence and never let untrusted raw mention frequency become canonical relation authority.

findings.claim: Synthesizer applies later source/coherence/story filters for normal retrieval, while preloaded story clusters skip those downstream gates; these filters occur after raw graph ingestion.
findings.implication: Presentation/article quality cannot retroactively upgrade raw graph evidence; preloaded clusters need their own quality/provenance receipt.

findings.claim: Genesis sandbox again uses temporary subprocess containment without a demonstrated OS security boundary such as namespaces/seccomp/bwrap/firejail/chroot/setrlimit in the selected source.
findings.implication: Sandbox experiment success is not effect authority; use external capability isolation.

findings.claim: Pip agent explicitly identifies itself as an on-demand robot companion HTTP service, not a permanent service/research daemon.
findings.implication: Do not count companion behavior as autonomous research/core cognitive evidence absent a current architecture contract.

branch_feedback.goodman: Treat self-generated idle/conversation confirmation as shared ancestry, not replication.
branch_feedback.harness: Add self-confirming-hypothesis, lexical-proxy false-positive, untrusted-source co-mention and preloaded-quality-bypass fixtures.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Evidence/source credibility and relation truth must be typed separately from storage/activation/co-mention frequency.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Co-mention edge may be an evidence/association edge but must not inherit canonical relation confidence merely from raw source count.
branch_feedback.frank: Hypothesis statuses require evidence-class/ancestry receipts; local confirmed != scientifically supported.
branch_feedback.emergenz: Never promote emergence/mechanism claims from passive self-text agreement without interventions/nulls.
